Note: This is the exact same simulation of the Su-25 as featured in DCS: Flaming Cliffs 3.

The Su-25 'Grach' (Rook), NATO callsigned 'Frogfoot', is a dedicated strike attack aircraft designed for the close air support and anti-tank roles. The Su-25 has seen combat in several conflicts during its more than 25 years in service. The Su-25 combines excellent pilot protection and high speed compared to most dedicated attack aircraft. It can be armed with a variety of weapon systems including guided missiles, bombs, rockets, and its internal 30mm cannon.

The Su-25 is the forerunner of the Su-25T (included for free in DCS World) and has much in common with the Su-25T. Although the Su-25 lacks some of sensors and weapons of the Su-25T, it provides better flight performance and is a more simple aircraft to operate. The Su-25 has been produced in great numbers and has seen service in many air forces around the world; more so than any later version of the 'Frogfoot'. 

Su-25 for DCS World  focuses on ease of use without complicated cockpit interaction, significantly reducing the learning curve. As such, Su-25 features keyboard and joystick cockpit commands with a focus on the most mission critical of cockpit systems.

Features:
Detailed and accurate 3D model and animations
Six Degrees of Freedom (6DOF) capable cockpit
Advanced Flight Model (AFM)
Campaign and missions
Both Simulation and Game modes

apps.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

apps.name: Age of Me
apps.short_description: An idle civilization game for desktop and mobile. From your first settlement to distant worlds, every discovery brings a new possibility. Build, research, and expand in an idle game designed for desktop and mobile, with offline production that keeps your civilization growing between visits.

apps.name: AHEIMER WAVES
apps.short_description: The sea took Omar's father. Now Omar takes the jobs his father left behind: pools, tanks and flooded rooms along the Red Sea coast. A first-person horror adventure where every job goes deeper, and something old is waiting in the water.

apps.name: All Night Ascension
apps.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler. Combine methods, artifacts and materials on a three-layer Bagua board, then face other players' builds in asynchronous duels. Try two sects in the free demo. An expedition mode with exploration, treasure hunting and bringing loot home is in development.

apps.name: All The Little People
apps.short_description: In this little world, you have a big mission to accomplish. To complete it, you'll find companions, participate in battles, and mingle with people. But you mustn't forget why you embarked on this path. As everything comes and goes, what game will all these little people become a part of?

apps.name: Amateur Football Together
apps.short_description: 5v5 cage football with your mates. Everyone controls one player, AI keepers guard the goals and bots fill empty spots. Pass, cross, dribble and shoot under the sunset lights. Quick matches, quick chat, no offsides.

apps.name: Among the waves
apps.short_description:
Carry the Divine Child. Bend the laws of physics and uncover the mystery of the Doors of Birth.
The fate of a world where artificial intelligence has learned to believe lies in your hands.

apps.name: AmplyVally
apps.short_description: Plan, build, and run your own festival. Design the site, build stages, book artists, manage infrastructure and visitor flows, and find out whether your plans survive the reality of festival day.

apps.name: An Immortal's Journey
apps.short_description: Begin a second life as an outer disciple in this cultivation RPG and visual novel. Choose your scripture, train, craft, take commissions, fight demon beasts, and get to know your fellow disciples as you balance daily sect life with the pursuit of immortality.

apps.name: AnimalBar
apps.short_description: A pixel-art animal ranch that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Every keystroke and click you make while working drops coins for your animals to collect. Hatch eggs, collect and fuse 48 species, unlock six habitats, and watch them nap when you step away.

apps.name: Another Pint
apps.short_description: Build and run your own medieval tavern in Another Pint, a systems-driven management game. Starting with little more than an abandoned shack, it is up to you to turn it into a thriving establishment. Grow your tavern, discover ingredients, and brew special drinks to keep your patrons coming back.

apps.name: ARSENAL FORGE
apps.short_description: Open crates. Feed weapons to favorites and forge them into legendary gear. Wield varied weapons and mount upgraded guns on turrets. Solo or in co-op for up to 3, fight hordes, protect your crystal, and break towers and bosses in an FPS blending roguelike builds, weapon upgrades, and tower defense.

apps.name: Ashen Wilds
apps.short_description: Ashen Wilds is a challenging survival experience in a brutal open world. Gather resources, build your base, and protect yourself from deadly creatures—and other survivors. Trust no one.

apps.name: Asteroid Patrol
apps.short_description: Bang bang! Shoot raining asteroids, dodge attacks of flying insects and battle against huge weird monsters! Gain exp, level up, pick perk and then rinse & repeat. Story? Nobody cares. If you are looking for a difficult and punishing game, don't leave without playing this one.

apps.name: Asteroid Watch
apps.short_description: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.

apps.name: Astra : Guardian of Stars
apps.short_description:
Astra: Guardian of Stars is a cute pixel-art party-building roguelike where you gather companions, build a party, and combine attribute and class synergies to survive enemy waves.
Your allies fight automatically while you move, choose items and augments, and shape a different build each run.

apps.name: Astragalos
apps.short_description: In Astragalos, players take the role of a person trapped in an impossible debt. To survive, they must gamble their own organs and attempt to recover them by participating in clandestine Craps matches, where luck, inventory management and modifier manipulation determine the course of each run.

apps.name: At Night
apps.short_description: Experience the horror of 'At Night', a horror-survival game where you face creatures and demons. Play online in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players. Conquer fears, gather resources, and defy the shadows of the night – an intense horror experience awaits!

apps.name: Aurora Core
apps.short_description: 1,000 sleepers, 100 waking hands and 1,500 light years of emptiness. As commander of the Aurora Core you assign your crew, ration oxygen and make decisions no one should survive. Will you bring your colony to Thalassa?

apps.name: Aurora Protocol
apps.short_description: Move in with a family friend, the missing owner of Artimus Corp, a tech mega-conglomerate. As androids act strangely and your dreams unravel, uncover the truth of your past in this adult cyberpunk visual novel where choices shape relationships and a growing harem.

apps.name: Aurora Sol
apps.short_description: Blamed for a catastrophe in Earth’s orbit, you’re a Space Salvager traveling the Solar System to clear your name. Steer drifting blocks through a zero-gravity sphere, match colors, and chain massive clears against real NASA imagery and an original soundtrack. Play solo, versus, or in VR.

apps.name: Awakening of Darkness: Build, Survive and Defend
apps.short_description: Build by day, defend by night. In limited daylight, manage light to expand your settlement. Endure brutal night sieges and protect your city's heart. Defy the dark with the power of ancient runes. Can you hold the light until dawn breaks?

apps.name: Backcheck Hockey Manager
apps.short_description: A hockey management game from people who play them. Rival teams value players like real front offices and tell you why they said no. Prospects grow by the minutes and coaching you give them. Run a pro team as general manager, head coach, or both.

apps.name: Bad Things Might Happen
apps.short_description:
Play as an AI Researcher whose wife left him because of his AI Psychosis, build an indoor data center and build the most complex AI model that has ever existed.
Social Commentary meets classic incremental mechanics. Begin progressing by hand, and then automate your way through AI development.

apps.name: Balliators
apps.short_description: Build a deck of wild balls, throw them into the arena and watch them bounce, collide and explode for points. A roguelike deckbuilder where every ball bends the rules: draft, roll, shop and beat four stages of bosses.

apps.name: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services
apps.short_description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

apps.name: Base State
apps.short_description: Build the fortress. Plan the assault. Fight for every flag. Base State is a tactical third-person shooter where your defenses shape the battle. Master five specialists, take on solo missions, and team up for 5v5 attacks and defenses.

apps.name: Baseline Boss: The Basketball Manager
apps.short_description: Coach a pro basketball team from the bench: pick your starting five, sign talent and make the calls live on a tactics board that cuts to comic highlights. A bold cartoon manager with story mode, trash-talk duels, voiced commentary and a real simulation underneath.

apps.name: Beach Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

apps.name: Beckon
apps.short_description: Salvation lies deep beneath blood-soaked earth. Survive horrors born of Scottish folklore alone or with your friends - improve your camp, hunt and forge powerful weapons and find ancient, game-altering magic. From the dark, you hear her Beckon - eat a hearty meal and get ready to descend once again.

apps.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
apps.short_description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

apps.name: Benthos
apps.short_description: Benthos is a co-op submarine exploration game set in the depths of an alien ocean. Coordinate your crew to pilot the sub, man the guns, hunt monsters, and complete high-risk missions. Build new underwater facilities, upgrade your vessel, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the ice.

apps.name: Best American Point And Click Adventury
apps.short_description: A Comedic Anthology of 2D Point-And-Click Adventures. Four games in the PNC style popularized in the 80's and 90's.

apps.name: Betty Boom
apps.short_description: A brave and undying warrior fights for freedom against an army of AI robots and their secret masters.  Armed with a dazzling array of weaponry, she battles to eradicate evil from the universe.

apps.name: Between Jobs : Fixer Sim
apps.short_description: Unlike most repair sims that keep you locked in one shop, Between Jobs : Fixer Sim gives you a semi-open town to explore. Fix phones, laptops, and consoles under real pressure, then step outside. Taxi to the bar, the carnival, or wherever the night takes you.

apps.name: Big Hearts
apps.short_description: Big Hearts is a match-3 dating sim about food, love and big appetites. Deliver to a town of eight hungry plus-size girls, chat them up, win dates by matching their favorite foods, and watch the scale climb before the kale-pushing Lean Machine ruins the Food Festival.

apps.name: Birza
apps.short_description: A desktop birding simulator.Here, you won't need to worry about feeding or raising the birds.Simply leave it running quietly on your desktop, and adorable birds will visit on their own.You can purchase food and feed them.Use the camera to capture their cute moments.Create personalized birding books.

apps.name: Bit Universe
apps.short_description: Grow a tiny voxel town into a solar-system economy. Build and upgrade neighborhoods, unlock districts, research technology and trade between worlds in a relaxed idle city builder. Includes desktop and optional PC VR, with shared Windows saves.

apps.name: Black Hole to Infinity
apps.short_description: Grow a tiny black hole in this idle game. It swallows asteroids on its own. You decide which cards to upgrade, when to start over for a lasting bonus, and when to spend the time you’ve saved to race toward Infinity.

apps.name: Black Powder Desolation
apps.short_description: Fight your way past the law with up to 3 of your friends in a coop campaign containing a variety of distinct locations and gameplay rewarding teamplay and cooperation, or master a variety of weapon classes against other players in thrilling battles featuring up to 24 players.

apps.name: BlackDog
apps.short_description: A dark themed pixel-art game of exploration, where you will have to find clues and solve puzzles to move forward in the story.

apps.name: Blood of Rome
apps.short_description: Lead a Roman legion through enemy hordes in a survivors-like where every level-up adds a new soldier. Evolve your troops, strengthen your general, and build an unstoppable army. Conquer for Rome.

apps.name: Bomb Disposal
apps.short_description: A touch-based puzzle simulation game. A woman has been strapped to a new type of bomb, and her heart rate is linked to its trigger. Remove the restraints and tasks across her body, make her climax, and defuse the bomb. Features animated scenes and 2 endings.

apps.name: BONG FLIP
apps.short_description: BONG FLIP is a fast-paced arcade game about launching, flipping, dodging enemies, and landing. Build your score, collect ridiculous skins, and see what you can survive before you crash. Flip it. Land it.

apps.name: Bonkaboo
apps.short_description: Bonk your friends off the table in this online physics party game for 2-8. Get knocked off and you come back as a ghost, dropping fans, bumpers and boulders on whoever’s still standing.

apps.name: Bookmark Hero
apps.short_description: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

apps.name: Borderfall
apps.short_description: Pick any country and fight a real time war on a real world map, solo or in online multiplayer with friends and strangers. Push the front, build, sign pacts, take vassals and trade hydrogen bombs. Play through plenty of historical scenarios while bots chase goals of their own.

apps.name: Boxes Grow Cats
apps.short_description: First, put a box on your computer desktop. Then wait, patiently. When the time comes, open it up and collect the cat that's grown inside. It really is that simple! Oh — and if you tuck a cat back into a box, it might just send a blessing your way.
developers: 幻想叙事工作室Mirage Tales Studio
publishers: 幻想叙事工作室Mirage Tales Studio

apps.name: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void
apps.short_description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

apps.name: Brawl the Flock
apps.short_description: Fight monstrous animals and insects with martial arts, unusual gear, and magic. Jump, guard, and combine light and heavy attacks to break through the hordes. Build your fighting style as you level up and smash voxel terrain to open a path in this survival brawler.

apps.name: Breadoria
apps.short_description: Breadoria is a survival colony sim where tiny Breads gather, build, craft, and defend their home from hungry invaders. Take control of any Bread, or automate your colony as you plan its next expansion.

apps.name: Brick Wright
apps.short_description: rick Wright: imagine it, build it! Place, paint and snap bricks together on your own plot or in endless open space, walk inside your creations as a brick figure, test what stands, then build whole cities, create your own mini-games and play them with friends.

apps.name: BUDD
apps.short_description: Join Eris Altair as she explores abandoned planets, battles monsters with her trusty BUDD units, and unravels the mysteries of the Lumina system in this cute sci-fi adventure platformer inspired by the games and anime of the late '80s.

apps.name: Bug Huntress wants to battle!
apps.short_description: "Fight me!!" A Bug Huntress who suddenly challenges you to battle — I've never met anyone this cocky. Hand over that ridiculous water gun of yours; I'm going to soak you from head to toe. Take this! Rapid-fire piston attacks straight to your weak point for massive damage!

apps.name: Buildcraft TD
apps.short_description: Build powerful defenses, expand your village, and unlock new technologies in this strategic tower defense game. Gather resources, strengthen your economy, and survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

apps.name: Bumpers & Dragons
apps.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

apps.name: BÉLA: Back to the Sea!
apps.short_description: Béla the whale is stranded, and he won't push himself. Grab buckets, logs and a winch, and roll him back to the sea with up to four friends online – while a live TV crew reports every mishap.

apps.name: Caprice: Rise or Ruin
apps.short_description: Caprice: Rise or Ruin is a choice-driven adult Femdom visual novel where domination, submission, and ambition collide. As Caprice plots to seize the Empire's throne, your choices shape your fate in a world of powerful women, seduction, and betrayal. Will you resist, submit, or surrender completely?

apps.name: Captain Contraband
apps.short_description: A pirate roguelike drawn on a 1600s sea chart. Trade, smuggle or plunder across a sea that's different every voyage, gamble on cursed Sacraments of terrible power, and outrun the ghost tide before it swallows the map. FTL meets Sid Meier's Pirates!

apps.name: Card Slay
apps.short_description: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Push your luck and turn poker hands into weapons: red suits strike, black suits shield. Forge your deck, unleash devastating rune combos, and outwit monsters that curse your cards and twist the rules. Think you can beat the House? Deal yourself in.

apps.name: Cargo Boats
apps.short_description: Build a little shipping network across an ever-growing world of islands. Draw routes, assign boats, and deliver cargo between coastal towns. Find your rhythm among gentle waves, winding coastlines, and increasingly busy harbors. Can you keep the cargo flowing?

apps.name: Carom Crashers
apps.short_description: Bank shots beat direct hits — x1.5 off one wall, x2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

apps.name: Carpet Racers
apps.short_description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

apps.name: Cases of the Past: Episode 0 - The Mysterious Neighbor
apps.short_description: Cases of the Past is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode reveals a terrifying story based on real experiences of those who survived.

apps.name: Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury
apps.short_description:
Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls.
Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses.

An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

apps.name: CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜
apps.short_description:
Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces.
Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure.
At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

apps.name: CatLands
apps.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Chains of Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description: A Three Kingdoms strategy roguelike. Battles are match-3, decisions are strategy. Build a different army every run from 50 generals and 6 formations, and march on Luoyang, where Dong Zhuo has made a pact with a demon.

apps.name: CHAOTIC VIRUS
apps.short_description: Fight to survive by controlling a cell in this top-down action roguelite. Destroy waves of viruses, gain experience, evolve through transformations, and create powerful combinations of active and passive abilities.

apps.name: Cheat The Chess
apps.short_description: Cheat the Chess! Learn by beating Stockfish 19. Play offline, use whispered hints and undo mistakes. 10 difficulty levels, 5 skill-building mini-games, 12 unlockable themes, Daily Puzzle, Lichess online, hand tracking, MR/VR, lying-down mode, custom shaders and more. Lose? Smash the board!

apps.name: Chief? About That File...
apps.short_description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

apps.name: Children of the Forest
apps.short_description:
Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat.

Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

apps.name: Chivalware
apps.short_description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

apps.name: Christmas Yarn 5
apps.short_description: A heartwarming match-3 adventure set in the snowy, sleepy village of Glimmerdale. When the frost wind created by a frightened frost-fox pup whisks away every child's Christmas wish into the Whispering Woods, only you and your magic yarn can save the day!

apps.name: CHRONO PUNK
apps.short_description: CHRONO PUNK is a Third-Person Action Roguelite, Combining high speed movement, intricate combat systems, and endless build potential. Customize your Stitch, Choose your Weapon, and Riot. Go Alone or Team up. Discover what awaits in the Clockwork and rebel against the Consortium. Time to go, PUNK!

apps.name: Cinderborn
apps.short_description: Cinderborn is a round-based witch brawl for 2-4 players in a fully destructible world of falling sand. Grab a loaded wand off the ground, draft spells between rounds and craft a wand of ultimate destruction. Annihilate your enemies... and probably mostly the world, honestly.

apps.name: Circora
apps.short_description: Circora is a first-person psychological horror set in a vast corporate entertainment complex. Explore its abandoned spaces, interact with strange systems, and use Child Mode to reshape how fear, distance and reality are perceived.

apps.name: Citystate Metropolis
apps.short_description: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.

apps.name: Clash of Adventurers
apps.short_description: Open-world indie MMORPG in development. The free Steam Playtest is LIVE NOW - open to everyone, instant access, no key needed. One class fills one role: Attacker, Defender or Supporter. Party up, fight monsters, gather, craft and quest across a seamless world with no instances.

apps.name: Close that strait !
apps.short_description: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

apps.name: Coasting
apps.short_description: A cozy online beachcombing hangout full of little android cats at the end of the world. Sweep the shore with your metal detector, dig up treasure, clean it off, show your friends, and give it a home. The tide brings more tomorrow. Take it easy… you’re coasting.

apps.name: Colección de Juegos de Mesa : Clasicos en familia
apps.short_description: 9 classic board games in one collection: Chess, Backgammon, Connect 4, Checkers, Dominoes, Battleship, Monopoly, Parcheesi and Snakes and Ladders. Play against the machine, hot-seat locally or online with friends over Steam.

apps.name: Collapsus
apps.short_description:
COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management!
Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

apps.name: Command Base Assault
apps.short_description: Ten fortresses, one river, five against five. Build your base, train an army of up to a hundred units and break the enemy HQs with your team in fast real-time strategy battles. Free to play, with cross-play between PC, iPhone and Android.

apps.name: Commander's Dilemma
apps.short_description: Build squads of 10 classes for 1v1 hex-based tactics. Alternate squad moves to defeat the enemy commander. Defend, counter, tighten or spread formations, and use formation attacks. Accuracy and evasion shape damage, not random hits. Seize mana points and teleport gates to deploy hidden reserves.

apps.name: Cooking Time in Astrawel
apps.short_description: Cooking Time in Astrawel is a restaurant management life-sim RPG. Play as a retired Hunter pursuing the dream of running a restaurant using rare ingredients gathered from mystery dungeons.

apps.name: Coraline
apps.short_description: A detective visual novel following a young woman named Coraline as she becomes drawn into her father's investigation.

apps.name: Corposlop
apps.short_description: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvest resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make better factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out your limited area.

apps.name: Corpus et Spiritus
apps.short_description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

apps.name: Corrupted Wings
apps.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

apps.name: Cozy Tent
apps.short_description: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

apps.name: Cricket Manager
apps.short_description: Build a global T20 dynasty across dozens of fictional competitions. Scout thousands of players, win auctions and transfers, develop youth, set fields and bowling plans, and watch every delivery resolve through a ball-by-ball match engine entirely offline.

apps.name: CrossVeil
apps.short_description: A card battler across four painted worlds. Hire guardians in the Exchange, build a deck for each world and battle through lantern-lit swamps, a neon arcade city, a crooked carnival and storm-torn sky islands. Every guardian brings its own ability to the fight.

apps.name: Crown of Lust
apps.short_description:
Prince Aldric has been sent across the Veil to forge peace with Lunaris — a kingdom where pleasure is sacred and women rule.
Navigate a world of seduction, political intrigue, and forbidden desire. But beneath the silk sheets something ancient stirs and only Prince Aldric can prevent an all out war.

apps.name: Crownkeeper
apps.short_description: Ride out by day, hire villagers and give them a trade, pay for every wall and tower coin by coin. When dusk falls, portals open on four sides. Hold the line until dawn, rebuild what was lost, and push your settlement outward until the portals themselves fall.

apps.name: Crystal Commanders
apps.short_description: Build. Command. Conquer. Take control in a fast-paced VR RTS packed with intense battles, dynamic defenses, and strategic depth. Survive brutal enemy waves, defeat epic bosses, and battle rivals online in explosive 1v1 multiplayer!

apps.name: Cubey Cove
apps.short_description: Cubey Cove is a tiny, cozy island builder. Stack cubes into beaches, hills and ponds, plant woods and build a little village, and make each wish come true. Twenty animals sail, swim and fly in to stay, each with its own habits and a best friend.

apps.name: Cultivator Idle
apps.short_description: An incremental idle xianxia themed RPG where you follow the path to immortality. Craft powerful pills, ascend the ranks of a sect, and face the tribulations of heaven.

apps.name: Cultprits
apps.short_description: Only your investigation can stop an Eldritch God from awakening... except some of you are secretly cultists.

apps.name: Custom Hero vs Epic Boss
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D platformer with RPG elements. Lead expeditions, level up your entourage, and loot rare gear from monsters. Master challenging platforming levels, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the secrets of the ancient Pact.

apps.name: Cyber Planet
apps.short_description: The World's Fastest Rage Game

apps.name: Dangerline
apps.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy game set in a modern war. Build a base, raise an army and fight street by street with two sides that play nothing alike. Walls and hills really block sight and bullets, so take the high ground, hold the houses and bring the town down on the enemy.

apps.name: Data-Miner
apps.short_description: A retro fake 1990s operating system, a quota, and a stack of phone books. Cross off names, mine them for data, sell it on a live marketplace, and eventually automate collection and sales.

apps.name: Daughter of Dawn
apps.short_description:
Only you can shape her destiny.

Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future.

An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

apps.name: Daydream Drifters
apps.short_description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from diverse foes—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

apps.name: DeathSlots
apps.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Cash --- If you run out of cash you die!! 💀

apps.name: Deiity (Under Ice)
apps.short_description: A dungeon crawler about working smart, not hard. As a fallen god, climb a buried antarctic temple to use humanities own weapons to destroy the earth. Use magic abilities to manipulate physics, enemies, and the environment as you fight man-made biological creations. The temple's secrets await.

apps.name: DepraviA
apps.short_description: In this side-scrolling action game, play as Angelica, an angel on a mission to save humanity. Use various weapons to fight, upgrade your skills with the souls of the fallen, and face the toughest foes ahead as you clear challenging stages! Will you save humanity from the brink of destruction?

apps.name: Desire Beach Holiday
apps.short_description: Desire Beach Holiday is an adult 3D dating simulation game where you step onto an island made for romance, spending unforgettable nights with five stunning, uniquely charming maidens. Amidst this azure paradise, let your desires run wild.

apps.name: Desktop Pet: Your Chibi Friend
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop pet that lives alongside you while you work, play or browse. Care for your little companion, play together, and watch them develop their own routines and adventures

apps.name: Destroy Buildings With Missiles
apps.short_description: An incremental physics-based destruction game. Destroy buildings to earn money. Spend money to upgrade your arsenal. Destroy some more buildings.

apps.name: Deus Mantle
apps.short_description: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

apps.name: Dirty Mind
apps.short_description: Take good care of your waifu and increase its perversion level. to do some nice things with her, and remember that waifu doesn't like salad! , the waifu is shy , so you will have to work hard to get what you want . prove your motivation to her!!

apps.name: DnB Starfighter
apps.short_description: A skill-driven space shooter where the only goal is a better run.

apps.name: Do Not Merge
apps.short_description: A short workplace-horror visual novel. You play as John, a fresh grad on his first day in IT ops. The office looks completely normal—your predecessor’s ThinkPad does not. Read the notes, analyze the logs, and decide who to trust. It all ends today.

apps.name: Don't Get Fired!
apps.short_description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

apps.name: DONT BE FOOL
apps.short_description: A 2-5 player online co-op puzzle platformer where nothing can be solved alone. Move and one button — that's all you get. Every level teaches one new rule, then asks you and your friends to survive it together.

apps.name: Doorstep Days
apps.short_description: Plan the route, beat the clock. Take food orders around a hand-painted Japanese town, stack deliveries in your bag, dodge jams and keep the food hot. Seven days, rising quotas, a big event every Sunday, and cards that grow your courier between deliveries.

apps.name: Down to Business
apps.short_description: Turn every dig into a bigger operation. Mine for valuable ore, take on contracts, upgrade your vehicle, and build your bases to reach as deep into the planet as possible.

apps.name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
apps.short_description: Collect cola and go after prizes too absurd to be real.

apps.name: Duck Me Please!
apps.short_description: Crank out dressed-up rubber ducks and fling them into the pools of a mysterious villa. Chain trick shots, upgrade your machines and open new pools for an owner who only speaks through old CRT screens and always wants MORE. The drain swallows every duck. Sometimes, it gives one back.

apps.name: Duck Your Friends
apps.short_description: An online party shooter for 2 to 8 friends. Shooters try to snipe the Duckers while they try to reach the safe haven at the end. Revenge is guaranteed as roles rotate every round!

apps.name: Dwarfspire
apps.short_description: Dwarfspire is an idle shopkeeper that sits on the edge of your screen. Manage a shop of hand crafted gear while sending expeditions of dwarves up mountains to gather rare materials and forge new items. Mine ore, craft items and become a master shopkeeper!

apps.name: E-xode: ROM
apps.short_description: A real-time multiplayer 4X set in a persistent galaxy of 729 sectors. Mine the belts, build a fleet, and push past the secured frontier into lawless space where patrols never reach and pirate stations trade with anyone. The galaxy keeps running when you log off.

apps.name: Echo of me
apps.short_description: Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. Explore a maze of memories, solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and uncover notes as you piece together a story in which every new answer changes the meaning of what came before.

apps.name: Edentopia
apps.short_description: An open-world sandbox ARPG where every weapon transforms how you fight. Hunt monsters, craft gear and create deep character builds through stats, enchantments, spells, equipment and pets. Explore freely, survive chaotic boss fights, and carve your path through a world of magic, danger, and discovery

apps.name: EdNoKa
apps.short_description: Five mini-games where correct answers power the play. Pick one of 36 quizzes (3,600 questions in math, science, social studies and language, ages 8 to 11), then farm, golf, fly or fight your way through it. Built by a family of three.

apps.name: Eldritch Drift
apps.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

apps.name: em.Path
apps.short_description:
Immersive witch and camping simulator set in a surreal world glitched beyond salvation.
Travel and maintain your RV, pickup strange hitchhikers, study the occult and rewrite the laws of nature

apps.name: Emergency Buddies
apps.short_description: Emergency Buddies is a co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players about the world's least qualified paramedic crew. Grab a call, floor it across town, and haul your patient to the hospital – alive, ideally! Drive fast and careful, trying to keep patients breathing.

apps.name: Encrafted
apps.short_description: Collect, refine, and craft with a vast array of materials, cashing out your most valuable creations to pass ever-rising profit goals! Leverage and synergise countless Artefacts, upgrades, and spells to become increasingly powerful in the addictive roguelike deckbuilding game Encrafted!

apps.name: Epokborn: From Stone to the Stars
apps.short_description: Survive, build, recruit, and evolve through entire ages of technology, solo or in co-op for up to 6 players. Rise from primitive tools to advanced industry, break into space, and explore your first playable galaxy in Early Access, then expand toward a far larger space experience on the road to 1.0.

apps.name: ERO FIGHTERS
apps.short_description:
Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?!
You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga.
Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

apps.name: ERROR：赛博男人和我的奇怪方块战斗
apps.short_description: A casual strategy game combining block-placement combat, roguelite module builds, and interactive stories for a female audience. Explore an anomalous network and conquer personalities who watch, respond to, and may even sense the real “you” as you claim your permissions.

apps.name: Escape Bunny Boss
apps.short_description: Escape Bunny Boss is a single-player horror game that plunges you into a Japanese office building. Explore the premises… or run for your life when the Boss spots you. Uncover the Boss’s secret to escape.

apps.name: Escape the Flood!
apps.short_description: A co-op survival crafting game for 1 to 10 players. The sea is rising and your island is going under. Chop down trees, craft a boat with your friends and steer it out to the open sea. Stay in the water too long, and the sharks will find you.

apps.name: ESCAPE: The Cabin
apps.short_description: Trapped in a remote cabin, solve over 70 puzzles and uncover your captor's identity in this first-person horror escape-room game. Inspect and combine items, follow hidden clues, and face randomised solutions that change between playthroughs.

apps.name: Evening, Boss.
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror about keeping a London cab firm located deep in the forest running after dark.

apps.name: EVILGARD
apps.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

apps.name: Fall, Fall, Fall for you
apps.short_description: "Fall, Fall, Fall for you" is a challenging ball physics platformer about falling over and over again to prove your love for Daisy. She laughs every time you fall, calling you a dumb idiot. B-But... maybe she doesn't mean it. Who knows?

apps.name: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
apps.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

apps.name: False Crown
apps.short_description: Face the ultimate test of skill as you master challenging raid bosses entirely solo in this action roguelite. Combine items and abilities to cast down the crowned and become the feared slayer of monarchs

apps.name: Femboy Futa Gym
apps.short_description: Save a struggling seaside gym in 12 weeks! Meet a cast of adult femboy and futanari characters, build relationships through your choices, and play 10 gym-themed minigames in a romantic visual novel featuring animated adult scenes and character-specific endings.

apps.name: Fener-G
apps.short_description: Aim, focus and burn with a lighthouse beam to survive each night against creatures rising from the fog. Pick an upgrade at every dawn. A mouse-only arcade survival game.

apps.name: Fetidity
apps.short_description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

apps.name: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental fishing game. Hire crews to catch, haul and process fish, gamble on upgrades at the casino, and keep your pile high so the monsters of the lake can't drain it. Then lay siege to each beast and compress the shore to start again, richer.

apps.name: FLEARUN!
apps.short_description: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players

apps.name: Flock & Load
apps.short_description: A 1v1 auto battler card game where your cards summon and multiply troops. Build six rows of chickens, knights, tanks and dragons, stack copies into stronger stars, then watch hundreds of troops fight it out on an open meadow.

apps.name: Flow Treehouse
apps.short_description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

apps.name: FLY GUYS
apps.short_description: FLY GUYS is a 3D open-world flying collectathon game. Play as an owl named Fly Guy, or his love in the sky, Fly Gal, and relax in this cozy atmosphere surrounded by nature. Fly high to discover new locations and explore the map, searching for eggs to rescue them all. Take on challenges, and explore!

apps.name: Forge Flow
apps.short_description: Forge weapons through a fast-paced clicker loop and build momentum as you upgrade your speed and progression.

apps.name: Forge More, Mole!
apps.short_description: Sell now, or try one more upgrade? Become a mole blacksmith and strike the anvil to raise your weapons' level and value. Head home after a day's trading, where unexpected events await to shake up your ordinary routine.

apps.name: Forget Me Notes
apps.short_description: You wake in a white room with no memory. No key will open this door. Type anything you like to the person inside, earn their trust, and recover what happened between you. Five women and no dialogue menus.

apps.name: Forgotten Grounds
apps.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

apps.name: Forty Days Dark
apps.short_description: Forty days of quarantine have failed. Sail a carrier across a world of over 500 unique cities, then fight street by street through Paris, Berlin and Rome in real time, with tanks, gunships and air strikes. Clear the Infected before the world goes dark.

apps.name: FoulKick Soccer
apps.short_description: Six-a-side arcade football with nobody in a black shirt keeping score of your crimes. Charge a super shot mid-jump, put the opponent on the grass with a harsh tackle, and spin a tornado kick into a loose ball. Six players on one couch, or take it online.

apps.name: Frame Fatale: A Minesweeper Gallery
apps.short_description: A picross/minesweeper hybrid where every correct tile reveals a little more of a hidden painting. 17 explicit scenes in total, fully animated, packed with nudity, sex, and dripping slime. No time limit, no fail state, just you, the grid, and 18+ content.

apps.name: Free Ball: Volleyball
apps.short_description: Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

apps.name: French Tax Simulator
apps.short_description: Take on the role of a tax inspector and track down tax evaders! Your mission: to reduce the public deficit. Cross-check the supporting documents, uncover inconsistencies and decide who to audit. Your career in the civil service depends on it....

apps.name: Gardenhood
apps.short_description: A cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Grow rare mutated crops, fish the pond, build and decorate your home, and hang out with neighbors in drop-in public lobbies — or tend your garden solo. Plant something weird. Show it off.

apps.name: Gatcha Gear
apps.short_description: Gatcha Gear is a side scrolling platform game where players will face challenging levels while guiding our tiny robot through a series of portals, each leading to a new bizarre and colorful dimension. Immerse yourself in a strange world, challenges, and excitement!!!

apps.name: gates of chaos
apps.short_description: Choose your character and step into the bloody arena! Annihilate zombie hordes and 15 unique enemy types. Buy lethal weapons from the shop; push your power, speed, and range beyond limits. Can you defeat the massive Bosses that spawn every 10 levels? Survive and dominate the arena!

apps.name: General please break through
apps.short_description:
An open world 3D shooting war casual game.
Drive tanks, anti-aircraft vehicles, mountain off-road vehicles, take hot air balloons, use kung fu-lightness skill, etc., collect materials, fight, hit planes, cross minefields and break through! Get out of here!

apps.name: Giggy Shangri-La
apps.short_description: Welcome to [Giggy Shangri-La], an exhilarating staff music action x live house management simulation. With guitar in hand, conquer dungeons and experience being a bartender at a live music club visited only by monsters! Would you like to explore the cute and eerie world with Yu Furuiido?

apps.name: Gladiadorks
apps.short_description: Gladiadorks is a goofy online co-op gladiator brawler. Slap your knocked-out friend awake, throw rivals across the arena and fight lions, elephants and a giant on your climb from a muddy village ring to the Colosseum.

apps.name: GNOME  REDUCTION
apps.short_description: Co-op for 1 to 4 grumpy grandpas. Sneak into a gnome village at night, grab the little pests with your bare hands, stuff them in a sack and sell them on the black market. The gnomes fight back, and the forest guardian is always watching.

apps.name: GoopUpClassic
apps.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule!

apps.name: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

apps.name: Gridiron Grit: Pro Football Dynasty Simulator
apps.short_description: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.

apps.name: Grindhouse Theater Simulator
apps.short_description: September 1983. Eighty seats, one projector, your choice of double bill. Run the Rialto in a first-person theater sim: book genre films, sell tickets and popcorn, hire the Grindhouse Gang and keep the show running when the print snaps and the crowd loses patience.

apps.name: Groove Core
apps.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

apps.name: Gun for Your Life
apps.short_description: A top-down Western roguelite shooter. Your bullets land exactly where you aim, so you can shoot past one bounty hunter and hit the one behind him. Build your outlaw between waves, then hide in the bushes or rush in the open. Somewhere out there is the man who put a price on your head.

apps.name: Gun Gone Wrong
apps.short_description: A first-person survivors-like: trapped parents, a real gun in each hand, and hordes of teddy bears. Shoot your way out of child TV hell.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13
apps.short_description:
Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13 is a free custom modification for Half-life 2.
The game takes place a month before the events of Half-life 2. The mod is an action, with often changing locations and first-person shooter.

apps.name: Harvesters
apps.short_description:
A short incremental game about gathering resources on different planets. Upgrade the harvesters, unlock new buildings, and unlock new ways to gather resources!
It's all about watching lil people do their thing.

apps.name: Havenhold
apps.short_description: 《决战万界山》是一款洪荒武道题材宗门沙盒网游。武者们通过丰富的技艺制造游戏内的一切物品，并通过集市自由议价赚取武道资粮。积攒财富，加入宗门，建设驻地，携手同门在激烈战斗中与宿敌争夺一统江湖的机会！

apps.name: Headstone
apps.short_description: A 3D arcade wave shooter in a moonlit graveyard. As the gravekeeper, blast zombies, skeletons, vampires and ghosts as they claw out of their graves, spend your score on new guns between waves, and hold out alone or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Hearth Fable
apps.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

apps.name: Hemobloom
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

apps.name: Hentai Academy: The Last Summer We Lied
apps.short_description: An 18+ visual novel about the last summer in a Japanese seaside town, a girl from the past — and the lie that once drove them apart.

apps.name: High School Blood
apps.short_description: Confront your darkest guilt and uncover the terrifying secrets of "St. Alengar School." Navigate bizarre rules, mysterious medicine, and form bonds with 5 unique club presidents. Will your choices lead to a horrific demise, or true love? Your destiny is in your hands.

apps.name: Hina Cast ! : After Dark
apps.short_description: Become Hina, a talented magician from the prestigious Osta Royal Institute! Live a double life as a researcher by day and ManaVision star by night. Defeat magical creatures with flashy combos and spells while making choices that determine Hina's fate and lead to success!

apps.name: Holy Dig!
apps.short_description: Dig away an entire mountain, one rock at a time. Earn coins from digging, buy better tools, and make every swing count. A satisfying incremental game with one very big goal: turn a mountain into an empty space.

apps.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
apps.short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

apps.name: Horde Lab
apps.short_description: A maze-building tower defense against hordes of thousands. Raise walls, build 15 kinds of defenses, pick a card every wave and unlock a 562-upgrade skill tree. Slow-motion missiles, a boss every wave and endless waves: how far can you go?

apps.name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Kill Line
apps.short_description: One card per turn. Rent, debt, and no room for mistakes. Build a deck around cash flow, evidence, and mutual support to survive mounting bills. A darkly funny, story-driven roguelike deckbuilder about a 38-year-old father trying to keep his life together.

apps.name: How to Chemistry
apps.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

apps.name: I hate progress bars
apps.short_description: A short incremental clicker about the progress bar that stops at 99%. Destroy bars by hand, unlock skills that click for you, and fight through installers, updates and a blue screen — one bar at a time, then hundreds at once.

apps.name: Idle War Legion: WW2
apps.short_description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

apps.name: Ilhumia
apps.short_description:
Enter the world of Ilhumia populated by pretty creatures.
Build your deck and fight other players alone or with a friend in this colorful multiplayer card game.
But becareful ! Angel the possessed girl rules on this world.

apps.name: Increment Isle
apps.short_description: Increment Isle is an incremental game about plundering a mysterious island. Destroy everything, discover new resources, strategically buy upgrades and avoid scurvy to become the richest person in the universe!

apps.name: Island Miner
apps.short_description: Island Miner is an automation game about expanding your factories across a vast island empire. Mine and refine ore into advanced materials, connect islands into a production network, then buy new ones with profit from a shifting galactic market. No enemies, no timers, just smart logistics.

apps.name: Ivory Cage
apps.short_description: Descent with your team into the depths of an abandoned theme park to repair its broken machinery, and survive what's still down there.

apps.name: Jester`s Anger
apps.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

apps.name: Jumping Cow
apps.short_description: One cow, split keys! A hilarious physics-based co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Coordinate your keys, time your jumps, conquer wild obstacles, and unlock fun dances together!

apps.name: Just a Turkey Leg
apps.short_description: This is a romance visual novel rotating around a murder mystery, with multiple-endings and gender selectable protagonist.

apps.name: K-Pop Rising - Dream to Shine
apps.short_description: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

apps.name: Kanji Unsealed
apps.short_description: Fight monsters with vocabulary instead of swords. Practice Japanese or Simplified Chinese by typing words to attack, counter enemy spells, and build your party. Help the hero to recover their memories and save the kingdom from an ancient evil being. Your only weapon is your own keyboard.

apps.name: Keepers of Kur
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op horror game where hunters track cursed objects using a mirror that shifts between two parallel dimensions. Survive haunted missions, outsmart possessed creatures, and recover supernatural artifacts together.

apps.name: KingFish
apps.short_description: A 2-player asymmetric co-op game where a King and a giant Fish, a living island, build a city, travel between islands, and defend their kingdom together. One plans from above. The other fights on the ground. Together they stand.

apps.name: Kinsoku Ryokan
apps.short_description: Follow the ever-changing taboos, complete your exorcism missions, and make it back alive. A horror action game featuring the story of Satomi, an apprentice shrine maiden, and online play for up to 8 players.

apps.name: Kitten Wool Cup
apps.short_description: Play solo or with friends in chaotic kitten soccer matches where the ball is a giant ball of yarn. Slide, tackle, pounce, and score your way through the Kitten Wool Cup, earn wool after every victory, and decorate your cozy cat house with furniture as you chase championship glory.

apps.name: Kovan-G
apps.short_description: Be the queen's scent: lead a living swarm of hundreds of honeybees to the flowers with your mouse and carry the honey home to a straw skep. Cook hornets in a heat ball, scatter from diving swallows and keep the colony fed through 12 summer days.

apps.name: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
apps.short_description: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.

apps.name: Las Locas Aventuras de Patricio
apps.short_description: An indie game full of humor and chaos where you must survive absurd game modes in Patrick’s wacky adventures.

apps.name: Last Card Dungeon
apps.short_description: Last Card Dungeon is a roguelite autobattler where your soul is trapped across a cursed deck. Explore a forsaken world. Collect powerful equipment. Tap and discard cards to battle enemies, survive events, and hunt the hooded figure who imprisoned your spirit...before your deck runs dry.

apps.name: Last Save
apps.short_description: Prehistoric survival for 2–4 players. Hunt, craft tools and keep your shared campfire burning. Split the work and talk through built-in voice chat. Prepare to face the Black Giant. Solo play is also available.

apps.name: LAST WITCH
apps.short_description: Ten witches marked by fate are drawn to an isolated island to fight until one remains. A single-player Battle royale Simulation on an eroding 6x6 grid. Master 50 weapons and skills to survive, and discover rich story episodes and death records for all 10 witches.

apps.name: Laylines
apps.short_description: Six challengers, one defender, the oldest trophy in sailing. Lead your syndicate from headquarters to the race course: crew, shipyard, sponsors, weather — and match race duels decided on the water, under real racing rules. History isn't bought: it's conquered.

apps.name: Leafborn
apps.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

apps.name: LEG DAY: Four Steps Through Hell
apps.short_description: Control a single leg in a brutal physics-based precision platformer. Balance, jump and master momentum through four increasingly absurd stages. One bad move can send you falling.

apps.name: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine
apps.short_description: Play as Captain Grégoire Lefèbvre and investigate the murder of a controversial country priest in this gripping historical detective thriller.

apps.name: Lexomancy
apps.short_description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

apps.name: Lich
apps.short_description: A first-person dungeon crawler built on D&D 5e SRD rules. Build a party of four, take quests in the haunted town of Myrkheim, and descend through ten levels of crypts, catacombs and dwarven halls, with caves and sewers to explore along the way. Do you dare face what lurks below?

apps.name: Lily出生之前
apps.short_description: A 2D text adventure game. Will the "virtual pet" you raise turn into a "living girl"? The game contains mild psychological horror elements such as weirdcore and generative horror. It can be completed within one hour, with 17 growth forms and 14 endings to collect.

apps.name: LIMINOID
apps.short_description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

apps.name: LineManager
apps.short_description: Build your own bus and tram network on real-world maps. Lay out routes and stops, match timetables to your vehicles and keep services running. LineManager is a transport building and management game in development, starting in Naumburg, Germany.

apps.name: Little Dungeon
apps.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

apps.name: Little Lands
apps.short_description: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

apps.name: Little Pocket
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop game where you can decorate a Little Pocket exactly to your liking, unlock new furniture, and share the space with an adorable pet companion. Create a relaxing little corner that keeps you company while you work, study, or play.

apps.name: Loadpath
apps.short_description: LOADPATH is a physics-driven demolition game about finding the supports that matter. Cut through industrial structures, trigger massive collapses, recover Salvage, upgrade your demolition rig and descend deeper through seven increasingly dangerous sites.

apps.name: Lostade
apps.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

apps.name: Love and Salvation Simulator
apps.short_description: 《大爱仙尊模拟器》是一款开放世界RPG，身为掌门不仅要提升自身修为，还要强大宗门实力。您扮演蓝夏与蓝珂兄妹，不择手段的活下去。黑暗孕育出恶之花，在没有人伦道德的约束下，在未来等待着的，是何等的欢愉……

apps.name: Lovecraft Tavern
apps.short_description: Take over as the manager of a cozy, cosmic-horror tavern. Mix anomalous ingredients into custom cocktails and test them on your unsuspecting patrons. Watch your recipes trigger grotesque Lovecraftian transformations, bend minds, and rewrite the reality of whoever takes a sip.

apps.name: Lucky Shot VR
apps.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

apps.name: Lumia: Street Obsession
apps.short_description: Lumia: Street Obsession — high-octane clicker-puzzle with seductive 3D visuals. Race the timer, break through her defenses, unlock intimate animated scenes and feel the Fever Mode as you drive the wild Latina beauty wild. Fast. Tense. Addictive.

apps.name: Lunio
apps.short_description: Guide a fragile balloon through a lethal test facility in this high-stakes physics puzzler. Navigate treacherous traps, dismantle robotic security, and uncover the dark secrets behind the experiments before time runs out. One pop and it’s over.

apps.name: Machina Blue
apps.short_description: Become a mech pilot in Machina Blue, where RPG and shooter elements blend together to deliver the soul of retro anime in a unique way.

apps.name: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
apps.short_description: The Bridge That Must Not Be Named became the main DVIZHUHA. Go online, one on one: take the wheel of the tanker that survived and deliver the fuel, or pilot the FPV drone and make sure IT never arrives. And it's all in PS1 style. Weather favors the operator, smoke and a jammer favor the driver.

apps.name: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
apps.short_description: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

apps.name: Magna Regna
apps.short_description: Magna Regna combines the nostalgia of the classic medieval RTS genre with a modern look and gameplay. Explore medieval history through various campaigns from the 9th century up to the very last time of knights. Play with your battle-hardened friends against others in multiplayer.

apps.name: Main Street Operator
apps.short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

apps.name: Make My Car
apps.short_description: Make My Car - will take you into the automotive world. Starting in a small, old factory, you are given a golden opportunity to become a part of somethin big. Sell cars, expand your factory, hire staff, and develop innovative models to dominate the automotive market.

apps.name: Making Room?
apps.short_description: An unpaid-rent argument leads Var to a house book that changes her housemates whenever they cross the kitchen threshold. A short psychological horror visual novel about living together, resentment, and making other people easier to bear.

apps.name: Mantradox Untitled
apps.short_description:
In a new RPG from the developer of Moon River, you are a doctor called to investigate a mysterious illness from the other side of the world.
Featuring a deep story, fast turn-based combat, and reassignable classes, you must cleanse the holy city, and discover the devastating truth behind the plague.

apps.name: marblebuilds
apps.short_description: A creative marble physics sandbox. Place blocks on an infinite grid to build anything you can imagine: marble runs, functional calculators, precision platformer courses, playable minigames, pinball machines, automated music tracks, and more.

apps.name: Meowmentum
apps.short_description: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and become a conduit of Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

apps.name: Metaversus
apps.short_description: Playtest signups are open—request access below. Your consciousness has been uploaded to the metaverse. Promised a utopia, you've instead been recruited into a cyber war for the world's hardware. Fight for map control with your team. Build, buy equipment, fight & destroy enemy builds, repeat.

apps.name: Micro Reinos
apps.short_description: MicroReinos is a first-person action RPG featuring roguelite elements and retro pixel art. Explore a microscopic world, choose your class, develop your skills, and face off against creatures and bosses across ten realms filled with dangers and mysteries.

apps.name: Midnight Bell
apps.short_description: A gothic PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight another player's team of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

apps.name: Mine It All!
apps.short_description: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.

apps.name: Mischkablaster
apps.short_description: Fast, chaotic bomb action for up to 10 players at one PC or online. Blow up crates, grab power-ups, dodge diseases - and survive the collapsing arena. Plus a solo campaign with bosses, tournaments and replays.

apps.name: Mise en War
apps.short_description: Mise en War is a party game of endless kitchen chaos. Complete your recipe before other chefs steal your food. Or simply steal their food instead of cooking.

apps.name: Miss Paint
apps.short_description: Edit the levels with classic image editing tools such as scale, rotate, copy, move, and more in Miss Paint; a puzzle platformer that takes place in a nostalgic computer interface! Utilize each different color's unique mechanics and rules to lead Miss Paint to victory!

apps.name: Mojo Is Loved
apps.short_description: Mojo is about to crashout because he's 25 and isn't a world famous musician yet... Tragic! So he makes it everyone else's problem with a new song. His friends love it. They support him unconditionally... Sorry, unconditionally?

apps.name: MOLTYN
apps.short_description: MOLTYN: Superhero destruction sandbox where every pixel is simulated: rock, water, lava, ice and metal melt, flood, freeze and collapse for real. Every power of the earth, 18 missions, kaiju fights, free-play worlds and CREATE, a level editor with level sharing. Early Access 12 Nov 2026.

apps.name: MoncooMoncoo!
apps.short_description: Join Spoony, the little chef, as you explore a dungeon filled with dangerous yet delicious monsters and restore the world's lost flavors!

apps.name: MONOLYTH
apps.short_description:
A Journey of Self-Deflection. MONOLYTH is a single-player arcade game, one-bullet bullet hell experience, and two-character play rolled into one.

One rainy afternoon, we came across three TV screens reflecting on divinity. We decided to capture this in the only way we knew how: By making a game.

apps.name: Monsterful Tavern
apps.short_description: Perfectly balanced blend of running a tavern for monsters, deck... ahem, menu-building mechanics and serving delicious knight meat. Seasoned with dark humor and a deliciously gory kick of umami. Bon appétit, kek!

apps.name: moorestech
apps.short_description: Factory automation meets anime-style RPG. Harness gears and shafts to power machines and conveyors, building an automated factory. Produce items and research tech, evolving from windmills to fusion as you trace humanity’s tech evolution, then launch a rocket home to uncover the truth of your exile.

apps.name: Moose Migration
apps.short_description: Join the ancient journey moose have made every spring for thousands of years. Shape your own moose, follow the migration through beautiful forests, wander off the path, discover the unexpected, and get into plenty of goofy situations along the way.

apps.name: Moraff's Dungeons
apps.short_description: A faithful remaster of all of the classic, grid-based, first-person, dungeon crawling, RPG gameplay from Moraff's Dungeons of the Unforgiven with options to add in some of the best from Moraff's World and other balance adjustments, all in a modern, accessible interface.

apps.name: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions
apps.short_description: Begin in Qi Refinement and follow the path of cultivation in a desktop idle RPG. Journey with fellow cultivators through battles, study techniques, gather treasures, and refine equipment as you prepare for each realm breakthrough.

apps.name: Most Jiggly Elimination Challenge
apps.short_description: A 3D physics obstacle course game show set over the ocean. No story, only fun, and only busty, bouncy babes. It's an addictive, yet frustratingly good time, with some great eye candy to keep you going.

apps.name: Mr. "Bargain Expert" 捡漏王
apps.short_description: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

apps.name: Mt. Quack Legend
apps.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join an new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

apps.name: Mushroom Mushroom
apps.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer. Control a small mushroom, create clones, and swap positions with them. Master clone swapping through puzzles and challenges, explore the many possibilities of this ability, overcome obstacles, and help the mushroom find its way home.

apps.name: My Ex-Future Family 3: Endgame
apps.short_description: You have 30 days to save Janna and her family from losing their home. Take on your arrogant new neighbors, get closer to the women in your life, and uncover the truth about your lost memories in this 3D visual novel for adults, full of romance, humor, and multiple endings.

apps.name: My Little Garden
apps.short_description: Grow a cozy little garden while you work, watch videos, or play other games! Plant crops, discover powerful synergies, complete contracts, and automate your farm. Enjoy relaxing idle progression in a compact desktop window — even when you're away.

apps.name: Myriad
apps.short_description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Every other round, enter a shop and strengthen your build. Gaze the stars in the night sky and score incredibly powerful line clears or just plain destroy the board as you see fit. Watch out for the constellations though...

apps.name: Mystics Ablaze
apps.short_description: Mystics Ablaze is a local multiplayer fighting game for 2-4 players where magi, spirits and occultists clash with colorful crystal orbs and explosive teleportation!

apps.name: N in One 数字逻辑游戏合集：数独、数织、数桥、数回
apps.short_description: Settle into a cozy collection of 20 logic puzzle types, from Sudoku and Nonograms to bridges, islands and hidden fleets. Explore 800 fixed puzzles across 10 levels per type, with offline play, separate progress, undo and redo, and illustrated guides to help you find your rhythm.

apps.name: Naked Ambition
apps.short_description: Naked Ambition is a "training" game with deck building elements in which the player influences a Princess vying for the throne.

apps.name: Nathan Cross: The Dorm
apps.short_description: You are moving into a new dorm and getting to know your new neighbors. But lately, something strange has been going on there. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the old dormitory to uncover its secrets.

apps.name: Neon Horde
apps.short_description: A neon action survivor: endless hordes, auto-firing weapons, and screen-clearing evolutions in 15-minute runs. The twist? You keep earning coins EVEN WHILE THE GAME IS CLOSED. Come back, spend them on permanent upgrades, master 7 heroes, and hit the arena stronger every single time.

apps.name: Neon Rhythm +
apps.short_description:
Every song is a boss fight in this hand-drawn dual-screen rhythm game. 
Time your moves to the beat of the music, or make your own custom tracks.

apps.name: NETWORK & CYBER SECURITY SIMULATOR
apps.short_description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

apps.name: Neverpaw
apps.short_description: Fight monsters, explore dungeons, and dive into a fun adventure in a 2D top-down world. Play solo or bring your best friend along in co-op — because every adventure is better together!

apps.name: NEXT OBJECTIVE
apps.short_description:
The objective marker IS the monster.
Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

apps.name: Nezori
apps.short_description: A cute action RPG adventure about a fox girl searching for the legendary hot springs in a world of fox and wolf girls. Help cute fox girls, fight deadly wolf girls, and occasionally come across the playful little fox girl Hana during your journey.

apps.name: Nightscape
apps.short_description: A young girl and her goat friend explore a world where the stars have fallen to earth. Nightscape is a 2.5D atmospheric adventure where you wield stellar powers, explore an ancient Arabian land, and overcome deadly creatures. Help Layla return the stars to the sky and find her missing father.

apps.name: NitorInc.: Touhou Microgames!
apps.short_description: (Demo available) An ongoing, collaborative Touhou Project fan game full of rapid-fire microgames YOU can help make! Nitori Kawashiro has brought video games to the fantasy world of Gensokyo, and she intends to capitalize on it with as many diverse games as possible, so you'd better think fast!

apps.name: No One Came Back
